1.title: Sunrise City
1.description: A bright, upbeat pop anthem with glossy synths and a high-energy chorus made for the start of a great day. Great for morning playlists, workouts, or feel-good road trips. Fans of Dua Lipa, The Weeknd, and CHVRCHES will feel right at home.

2.title: Midnight Coding
2.description: A mellow lo-fi beat with warm, dusty textures and a relaxed late-night pulse. Ideal background music for coding, studying, or winding down after dark. Similar in vibe to Nujabes, Idealism, and the Lofi Girl catalog.

3.title: Storm Runner
3.description: A driving, high-intensity rock track with fast tempo and aggressive guitar energy. Perfect for intense workouts, gaming sessions, or powering through a deadline. Recommended for fans of Foo Fighters, Royal Blood, and Muse.

4.title: Library Rain
4.description: A soft, highly acoustic lo-fi piece with a slow tempo and gentle, rainy-day calm. Best suited for deep focus, quiet reading, or relaxation. Comparable to the softer side of Tomppabeats, Kupla, and aso.

5.title: Gym Hero
5.description: An explosive, high-energy pop-workout track built to push your heart rate. Made for the gym, sprint intervals, or any moment you need a jolt of motivation. Sits alongside Sia, David Guetta, and other big-room pop-dance artists.

6.title: Spacewalk Thoughts
6.description: A slow, deeply atmospheric ambient soundscape with airy pads and near-weightless calm. Ideal for meditation, sleep, or drifting into deep focus. Evokes Brian Eno, Stars of the Lid, and Tycho's quieter moments.

7.title: Coffee Shop Stories
7.description: A relaxed, acoustic-leaning jazz tune with a warm, easygoing swing. Perfect for a slow morning, a cozy cafe, or dinner-party background music. Fans of Norah Jones, Chet Baker, and Bill Evans will enjoy it.

8.title: Night Drive Loop
8.description: A moody synthwave cut with retro neon textures and a steady midnight groove. Tailor-made for late-night drives and cinematic, introspective moments. Recommended for fans of The Midnight, FM-84, and Kavinsky.

9.title: Focus Flow
9.description: A steady, focused lo-fi groove with clean rhythm and minimal distraction. Great as a study or deep-work loop when you need to stay in the zone. Similar to Jinsang, Sweet Medicine, and other focus-oriented beatmakers.

10.title: Rooftop Lights
10.description: A happy, danceable indie-pop track with jangly guitars and a sunny, uplifting chorus. Perfect for summer hangouts, parties, and golden-hour gatherings. In the lane of Two Door Cinema Club, Foster the People, and Phoenix.

11.title: Stateside
11.description: A bright, radio-ready pop banger with a big, joyful hook and polished production. Ideal for parties, playlists, and feel-good singalongs. Sits right alongside Zara Larsson, Rita Ora, and Ava Max.

12.title: I Just Might
12.description: A playful, groovy pop track with retro flair and an infectious, hearty, danceable rhythm. Perfect for parties, dance floors, and lighthearted good times. For fans of Bruno Mars, Silk Sonic, and Mark Ronson.

13.title: Golden Hour Waltz
13.description: A dreamy, richly acoustic classical waltz with a slow, graceful tempo. Beautiful for weddings, quiet reflection, or elegant background ambiance. Reminiscent of Ludovico Einaudi, Yann Tiersen, and Max Richter.

14.title: Forest Lanterns
14.description: A warm, romantic folk song with acoustic guitar and a heartfelt, storytelling feel. Great for cozy evenings, campfires, and intimate moments. In the spirit of The Lumineers, Fleet Foxes, and Iron & Wine.

15.title: Beat Street
15.description: A high-energy, party-ready hip-hop track with a heavy beat and bold attitude. Made for pre-games, dance floors, and hype playlists. Recommended for fans of Travis Scott, Metro Boomin, and Baauer.

16.title: Island Sun
16.description: A calm, sun-soaked reggae groove with laid-back rhythm and easy warmth. Perfect for beach days, backyard hangs, and slow afternoons. Channels Bob Marley, Toots and the Maytals, and Stick Figure.

17.title: Shadow Throne
17.description: A dark, high-intensity metal track with heavy riffs and a melancholic, brooding edge. Built for intense focus, heavy workouts, or cathartic listening. For fans of Trivium, Gojira, and Bullet for My Valentine.

18.title: Country Roads
18.description: A soulful, mid-tempo country song with warm vocals and a heartfelt, down-home feel. Great for road trips, porch evenings, and easygoing listening. In the lane of Chris Stapleton, Zach Bryan, and Kacey Musgraves.

19.title: Petal
19.description: A romantic, mid-energy pop ballad with airy vocals and a tender, glowing mood. Ideal for date nights, slow dances, and emotional playlists. For fans of Ariana Grande, Tori Kelly, and Camila Cabello.

20.title: Blue Moon
20.description: A dreamy indie-pop track with shimmering textures and a gently uplifting sway. Perfect for late-night reflection, city walks, and mellow playlists. Comparable to Lorde, Maggie Rogers, and Clairo.

21.title: California Dreaming
21.description: A dreamy, nostalgic song with warm acoustic guitar and a wistful, sun-faded mood. Great for coastal drives, lazy afternoons, and reflective playlists. Evokes The Mamas & the Papas, Fleetwood Mac, and Vance Joy.

22.title: How You Like That
22.description: A fierce, high-intensity K-pop banger with hard-hitting drops and a bold, commanding hook. Made for parties, hype playlists, and confident get-ready moments. For fans of BLACKPINK, TWICE, and ITZY.
